name: A Frightened Request

angles.text: The fall of Lordaeron remains a deep tragedy in human memory. As a human, you can see Edward’s desperate search as a reminder of the families torn apart when Prince Arthas destroyed his own people.

The ruins above the Undercity are held by the Forsaken, who rose from the kingdom’s ashes. As an undead, you know living humans still wander the shattered capital’s graveyard, in lands the Forsaken now hold.
As a priest, you can understand the grief that drives a father to search a graveyard for his lost son.

faq.answer: Edward Heartweaver is a grieving father whose son was lost when the Scourge destroyed Lordaeron. He searched the ruined capital’s graveyard each week for the child’s remains, then vanished.

aliases: why did edward go to lordaeron
faq.answer: Edward went to the Ruins of Lordaeron to search for his son’s remains. The boy was lost when Prince Arthas and the Scourge destroyed the capital, and Edward kept searching despite his wife’s warnings.
faq.q: Why did Edward go to the Ruins of Lordaeron?

faq.answer: The surface ruins of Lordaeron are overrun by hostile creatures and dangerous horrors. Ordinary citizens cannot safely travel there, making a long search perilous.
faq.q: Why are the Ruins of Lordaeron so dangerous?

faq.answer: Edward Heartweaver’s frightened wife asks for help after he fails to return from his weekly search. She turns to capable adventurers to find out what happened to him.
faq.q: Who offers the quest A Frightened Request?

faq.answer: The Heartweavers’ son was lost when Prince Arthas and the Scourge destroyed Lordaeron. His body was never found, leaving Edward grieving and searching for his remains.

aliases: what do i do in a frightened request
how to complete a frightened request
faq.answer: Edward’s wife asks you to search the dangerous Ruins of Lordaeron and discover what happened to Edward Heartweaver.
faq.q: What is the objective of A Frightened Request?

sections.body:
When the Scourge destroyed Lordaeron during the Third War, the Heartweavers lost their young son. His body was never found in the ruin. So Edward Heartweaver went each week to the capital’s graveyard, still hoping to find some trace of his child.

Grief and guilt kept Edward from letting go. The graveyard lay within the ruined capital, where the search was perilous.
sections.title: A Father's Grief

sections.body:
The surface ruins of Lordaeron are overrun by hostile creatures and lurking horrors. They are no place for ordinary citizens. Edward’s frightened wife warned him and begged him to stop going, but he kept to his weekly search.

Then Edward failed to return for several days. His wife turned to capable adventurers and asked them to brave the ruins and learn what had become of him.
sections.title: The Perils of the Ruins

summary: Edward Heartweaver’s wife waits in fear after he vanishes in the Ruins of Lordaeron. Since their son was lost when the capital fell, Edward has gone each week to search the graveyard for his remains. Now his usual journey has lasted several days.
attribution: In-game quest text: A Frightened Request
